summary: All three new/modified recognizers accept denial or pasted remedy vocabulary as affirmative evidence, suppressing their intended verdicts.
Thread.start failure escapes c71 after jq launch, crashing fleet verification and potentially leaking the child.
Multiple inline probes on one line inherit later probes' expectations and can false-FAIL.
Environment-reading filters execute under a scrubbed environment and can false-FAIL rather than being refused.
The three claimed independent mutation positives all reuse #2588 or its founding artifact.
